svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two rails 900 mm long (front and back).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four rails 410 mm long: two end rails and two cross rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw square, within 0.3 mm; deburr every end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay the frame upside down on a flat bench: the long rails run the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: full 900, the short rails fit between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross rails centred 150 mm each side of the middle (300 apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Join each meeting with one inside corner bracket on the inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: faces, two M5 x 10 screws and two drop-in T-nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Before closing the frame, slide drop-in T-nuts into the top slots:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 per long rail and 2 per short rail, for the deck screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: the deck sits on the top faces; the posts stand on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end rails and on the ends of the back rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: diagonals equal within 2 mm; frame flat on the bench.
